prompt:
Theme:
Sea breeze harbor walk

Subject:
Full-body photo of a woman walking along a breakwater in a clear sunny fishing port. Wearing a navy swimsuit and a white shirt, she holds a half-removed navy pleated skirt at thigh level with both hands. There is a man sitting in the back right and a fishing boat in the sea at the bottom left.

Person/Expression:
The woman faces the lower left of the screen, a calm profile with downcast eyes and slightly parted lips. Soft oval contour, narrow eyes, straight nose, natural coral lips. Black hair is a short bob, with bangs and tips flowing to the right in the strong sea breeze. The man in the back is small, looking up at the woman with his mouth open.

Clothing/Pose:
A navy high-cut one-piece swimsuit layered with a white button-down shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbows, left open, and a loosened dark ribbon at the collar. White ribbed socks and off-white low-cut sneakers. Holding the wet navy pleated skirt down in front of her thighs with both hands, she steps forward with her left leg. The hem of the white shirt flutters widely to the right.

Background/Light:
Vivid blue sea and moored small fishing boat on the left, rope in the right foreground, rusty mooring posts, yellow and black quay, green mountains and a harbor town in the far background. Large white cumulonimbus clouds stand on the right half. Hard direct sunlight from the sun above creates dark short shadows and reflections on the water surface.

Composition/Camera:
A 3:4 vertical, full-body portrait taken from a low angle looking up, capturing everything from head to shoes. The woman occupies the center, the advancing shoe is at the bottom right, and the head is in the top third. Focus on the woman, use a wide-angle feel to make the legs look long, while keeping the background clear with a deep depth of field despite the boat and man being small in the back.

Texture/Style:
High-definition photorealistic real photo. Depicts the hard textures of wet fabric and skin, wrinkles in the white shirt, seawater, rust, and sunlight in vivid blue and white.

Negative:
Integration of swimsuit and lowered skirt; omission of background man.
